column1: # B1200 (#519) live leg (oracle side): measure the WORN-equipment effect on the
# official client, lane 5, B1134 observer rig. Steady-state (not a cast).
# The epic 1.0s are NOT in the P1999 lane-5 DB (census_worn.sh: every item has
# minstatus=0; Jagged Blade of War = -1), so this measures the MECHANISM on an
# item that IS in the DB and carries a visible worn effect (spellanim<>0).
#   # ITEM = the worn item to summon. Default 8364 (Talisman of Vah Kerrath,
# EQUIP PREREQUISITE (the one open sub-problem): the item lands on the caster's
# cursor via `#summonitem`; equipping it needs a double-click, which the lane-5
# driver's jclick (oracle_remote.sh:70) cannot produce (~1.3 s of focus+drag
# delays). The FIX leg adds a `jdblclick` primitive (two mousedown/up ~100 ms
# apart) to oracle_remote.sh and swaps the two `click` lines below for one
# `dblclick`. Until then the two `click` lines are a best-effort fallback.
# (oracle_session.sh owns the lease, stack up/down, DB snapshot+restore, and
# pulls capture.pcap + video.mp4 back into <out_dir>; it renews the lease itself,
# so the caller does not need to hold one.)
# --- steady state BEFORE equip (no worn effect: the reference frames) --------
# EQUIP: double-click the item on the cursor (FIX leg: one `dblclick` line).
# Best-effort fallback (may not register as a double-click):
# --- steady state WITH the worn effect (the measurement window) --------------
